What could happen if Democrats win midterms?⁠ ⁠ Impeachment is back on the minds of Democrats as they sense a return to power after the midterm elections — but figures across the party are wary of launching a third attempt to bring down President Trump.⁠ ⁠ No American president has ever lost an impeachment conviction vote in the Senate, where a two-thirds majority is required for removal from office.⁠ ⁠ Moreover, the two Senate votes that Trump survived in his first term — after being impeached in the House of Representatives — appeared only to make him stronger in the eyes of his support base.⁠ ⁠ However, should they win back control of the House of Representatives, Democrats appear united that one of Trump’s cabinet secretaries should face the ultimate constitutional sanction to remove a federal civil officer for “treason, bribery, or other high crimes and misdemeanors”.⁠ ⁠ 🔗 Tap the link to read the full story by David Charter #presidenttrump #donaldtrump #impeachment #uspolitics #democrats
